rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something judged good, suitable, or worth wanting, especially an option or set of properties.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 zan1 hai6 lei5 soeng2

rows.note: Use this when desirable means broadly appealing or attractive, including sexual appeal when the context makes that clear rather than explicitly saying sexy.

example.english: This new design is very desirable.
example.traditional: 呢個新設計好有吸引力。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 cit3 gai3 hou2 jau5 kap1 jan5 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the attraction is explicitly sexual.

example.english: They look really desirable in this dress.
example.traditional: 佢着住呢條裙，真係好性感。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 ni1 tiu4 kwan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 sing3 gam2
